name: quiz-options
title: Quiz options
description: A multiple-choice question: pick one or several, lock it in, and every option is marked with an icon and a word, with a one-line reason.
docs: Pass question, options ({ value, label, reason? }) and correct (one value or a list). One right answer makes a radio group, several make checkboxes (multiple overrides). value (always a list), defaultValue and onValueChange control the choice. Check answer locks the question and marks every option that matters with an icon and a word, never colour alone: "Correct", "Your answer, incorrect", and for a right option left out "Missed" (several right) or "Correct answer" (one). A reason appears under its option once checked and is announced politely with the marks; the options stay focusable so a screen reader can walk the result. onCheck gets { correct, value }; the verdict panel is yours. status is controlled or kept inside; allowRetry turns the button into Try again, which clears the answer and calls onRetry. name submits one field per choice, labels translates.
